svg.title: Operational labor evidence and payroll cost support
svg.desc: Operational labor evidence and payroll cost support. Labeled solid arrows identify stored keys. Dashed arrows identify aggregation or analytical support. PayrollSummary posts directly to the ledger. Factory overhead and depreciation have separate journal routes. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
